suite: G5 Rate Cards & Pricing + G6 Leads / RFP Intake
observations: DELETE /leads/:id cascades to proposals.lead_id with ON DELETE SET NULL: the quotation survives but loses its traceable source lead, and nothing warns the caller.
BANT scoring could not be asserted end to end because the AI service on http://localhost:8000 is offline; the endpoint fails as 502 with the JSON envelope instead.
G5 pricing is asserted against the deterministic domain service: the AI service plays no part, so the same sheet must always produce the same total.
Rate-card list rows expose createdAt/updatedAt and the resolved numeric rates. Lead list rows drop rawRfpContent and bantDetails; only GET /leads/:id returns the full RFP text.

G6-11 cannot pass on this database: migration 006_discovery_meetings was baselined into schema_migrations without ever running, so meetings.organization_id does not exist and every meeting write answers 500. Applying it (additive columns only) needs approval because the Supabase dev database is shared.

results.title: Bootstrap: two organizations, a member and the rate-card fixtures used by the pricing matrix
notes: 9 cards in org A, 1 in org B

results.title: GET /rate-cards paginates, returns NUMERIC as JSON numbers and stays tenant-scoped
notes: rates are numbers, tenant scope holds

results.title: GET /rate-cards filters by role name, level, currency and active flag
POST /rate-cards validates rates, level default, currency and the unique (role, level, currency) key
notes: same role allowed in another tenant

results.title: RBAC: a VIEWER reads and prices but cannot write rate cards; anonymous callers get 401
GET/PATCH/DELETE /rate-cards/:id lifecycle, partial update and malformed or foreign ids
notes: monthly derived from daily on patch

results.title: Pricing input guards: empty list, oversized list, invalid effort and malformed references
Rate resolution: monthly wins, else daily x 21, else hourly x 8 x 21
monthlyRateOverride short-circuits the rate card and is reported as MANUAL_OVERRIDE
Pinned rateCardId wins over name resolution, inactive cards and foreign tenants are refused
Level matching falls back within the role and UNKNOWN_ROLE answers with the available role list
notes: level fallback keeps the same role

results.title: Currency selects the candidate cards and the calculation echoes a single currency
notes: EUR card only prices in EUR
a USD run cannot silently borrow the EUR card

results.title: Totals are cent-rounded and equal the sum of the lines for a realistic staffing sheet
Applying pricing writes the proposal once and leaves it untouched when apply is false
Pricing and rate-card writes are recorded in the audit trail
POST /leads persists an intake draft with the documented defaults
Lead writes validate required text, size limits and enums
Unknown or cross-tenant clientId/assignedTo references are refused on create and update
A client cannot move a lead into another organization by sending organizationId
notes: body organizationId and userId are ignored

results.title: GET /leads paginates and every filter is guarded
GET /leads/:id resolves own rows and answers 400/404 for malformed or foreign ids
PATCH /leads/:id updates partially, rejects an empty body and keeps unread fields
The lead status endpoint enforces the state machine
notes: APPROVED gated on a BANT score

results.title: A lead can be closed as WON or LOST only from a drafting or approved stage
notes: WON and LOST reachable from PROPOSAL_DRAFTING

results.title: A lead can only become a proposal once it is qualified
notes: QUALIFIED lead produced a proposal linked to the lead

results.title: Meetings attach to a lead through /leads/:leadId/meetings
Deleting a lead is idempotent-guarded and unlinks proposals instead of failing
notes: proposal survives with leadId null (ON DELETE SET NULL)

results.title: Every lead route requires authentication and never serializes credentials
RFP intake keeps its contract when the AI service is consulted
results.reason: semantic intake assertions need the AI service on http://localhost:8000; it is not running

results.title: Qualification endpoints guard authorization and tenancy before spending AI calls
results.reason: AI service offline: the /qualifications 502 path was asserted, the score shape was not

results.title: Lead writes are auditable like every other tenant mutation
